'''Al Scott''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 91 from Atlanta, Ga. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He learned the game from his brother-in-law Ken Harrison and ran tournaments in Atlanta.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
